fusions.name: Silver Scatter
fusions.desc: Flicks 3 slick scales up off the tines at once, spread apart, each dealing 4 damage, with a 30% chance per hit to leave the target [Slowed] for 2 seconds.

fusions.name: Landed Catch
fusions.desc: Reaches out to a target up to 6 tiles away and deals 18 damage, rising to 1.6 times that at full reach. Usable only on an enemy at or below 25% health.

fusions.name: Seine Haul
fusions.desc: Drags the tines through the shoal: up to 5 enemies within 6 tiles are pulled onto you and held there for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Netful
fusions.desc: Every time you land a hit, a stack builds on you, up to 8. The next ability you use spends them all: you move and attack 3% faster per stack for 6 seconds. Unfed, a stack fades every 6 seconds.
